title: FDA Approves First Treatment to Reduce Risk of Serious Heart Problems Specifically in Adults with Obesity or Overweight
book_use: Chapter 4; The Ozempic Economy; Checked 2026-09-02; Supports: Wegovy cardiovascular-risk-reduction indication; supporting trial enrolled more than 17,600 participants; major adverse cardiovascular events 6.5% with Wegovy versus 8.0% with placebo; Limits: Indication is for adults with established cardiovascular disease and overweight or obesity; do not generalize the cardiovascular outcome to all GLP-1 users.
